ra: Nuit is one of the principal deities of Liber AL vel Legis.
Hadit is one of the principal deities of Liber AL vel Legis.
Ra-Hoor-Khuit is one of the principal deities of Liber AL vel Legis.
Aiwass, the intelligence who dictated Liber AL, is central to the Thelemic pantheon.
Hoor-paar-kraat is the silent twin within the Thelemic godhead.
Babalon is a central deity of the Thelemic corpus.
Therion/The Beast 666 is a central figure of the Thelemic corpus.
Choronzon is the Thelemic demon of the Abyss within the system.
Hoor-paar-kraat is the Thelemic form of the Greco-Egyptian Harpocrates.
Babalon is Crowley's reframing of the biblical Whore of Babylon.
Therion/The Beast 666 is Crowley's reclamation of the apocalyptic Beast of Revelation.
Choronzon was first named in John Dee's Enochian records and later developed by Crowley.
Babalon and Therion (the Beast) are the paired feminine and masculine principles of the new aeon.
Hoor-paar-kraat is the silent passive twin of the active Ra-Hoor-Khuit, two aspects of Heru-ra-ha.
Ra-Hoor-Khuit is the warlike crowned-and-conquering lord of force and vengeance.
Therion is Crowley's prophetic magical office central to the practice of magick.
Choronzon is the power of dispersion and dissolution at the Abyss.
Aiwass is the intelligence who delivered the revelation of Liber AL.
Crowley identified Aiwass as his own Holy Guardian Angel.
Ra-Hoor-Khuit is the lord governing the Aeon of Horus.
Morya is one of the Mahatmas (Theosophical Masters of Wisdom).
Koot Hoomi is one of the Mahatmas.
Djwal Khul is one of the Mahatmas.
The Maha Chohan heads a department within the Mahatmas' hierarchy.
The Mahatmas form the human-adept tier of the Theosophical Spiritual Hierarchy.
Sanat Kumara, the Lord of the World, heads the Theosophical Spiritual Hierarchy.
The Solar Logos stands at the cosmic apex of the Theosophical hierarchy.
The Planetary Logos governs Earth within the hierarchy, subordinate to the Solar Logos.
The Lords of Karma administer the law of karma within the cosmic hierarchy.
The Root Races are the evolving humanities overseen by the Spiritual Hierarchy.
As Lord of the World at Shamballa, Sanat Kumara governs the spiritual evolution overseen by the hidden hierarchy.
The Masters of the Ancient Wisdom are the custodians of hidden wisdom in Theosophy.
The Lords of Karma administer the cycle of death and rebirth, though their domain is karma broadly.
The Secret Chiefs are the hidden Third Order said to direct the Golden Dawn.
The Golden Dawn was the foremost order of ceremonial magic in the modern revival.
The Secret Chiefs are the hidden source of authority and knowledge directing the Golden Dawn.
The Golden Dawn incorporated John Dee's Enochian system into its synthesis.
The Secret Chiefs parallel and were influenced by the Theosophical Masters.
